title: Airline & Fleet Strategy
problem: Operators face aircraft backlogs, delivery delays and fleet decisions that carry decade-long consequences.
response: NAP works alongside airline and fleet leadership to structure fleet expansion, renewal and transformation decisions grounded in operational reality.

title: MRO & Infrastructure
problem: Maintenance capacity, technical partnerships and lifecycle planning determine whether a fleet stays airworthy and competitive.
response: NAP helps structure MRO networks and infrastructure relationships built on decades of direct technical experience.

title: New Mobility
problem: Mobility is decentralizing. Regional and point-to-point models require infrastructure that does not yet fully exist.
response: NAP supports the design of village-to-village and point-to-point aviation networks and Advanced Air Mobility infrastructure.

title: Sustainable Propulsion
problem: SAF, hydrogen and electric propulsion each carry distinct infrastructure, financing, safety and regulatory requirements.
response: NAP helps operators and suppliers navigate the energy transition without treating every propulsion pathway as interchangeable.

title: Lighter-Than-Air
problem: Airships, balloons and heavy-lift platforms represent a distinct mobility category with its own safety and regulatory path.
response: NAP brings structured thinking to lighter-than-air systems as a serious, low-impact mobility and logistics category.

title: Aerospace & Space Materials
problem: Space systems, orbital logistics and advanced materials manufacturing form a new industrial frontier with its own supply chains.
response: NAP applies industrial and deep-tech experience to space infrastructure, advanced materials and orbital manufacturing ventures.
